title: Activation of Wnt/β-catenin signalling by mutually exclusive FBXW11 and CTNNB1 hotspot mutations drives salivary gland basal cell adenoma
authors: Wong K; Bishop JA; Weinreb I; Motta M; Del Castillo Velasco-Herrera M; Bellacchio E; Ferreira I; van der Weyden L; Boccacino JM; Rotundo G; Ciolfi A; Cheema S; Olvera-León R; Offord V; Droop A; Vermes I; Allgaeuer M; Hyrcza M; Anderson E; Smith K; de Saint Aubain N; Mogler C; Stenzinger A; Arends MJ; Brenn T; Tartaglia M; Adams DJ
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全外显子测序研究唾液腺基底细胞腺瘤的Wnt信号通路驱动突变，属于纯肿瘤基因组学与临床诊断研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Wnt signalling must be ‘just right’ to promote tumour growth. Basal cell adenoma (BCA) and basal cell adenocarcinoma (BCAC) of the salivary gland are rare tumours that can be difficult to distinguish from each other and other salivary gland tumour subtypes. Due to their rarity, the genetic profiles of BCA and BCAC have not been extensively explored. Using whole-exome and transcriptome sequencing of BCA and BCAC cohorts, we identify a novel recurrent FBXW11 missense mutation (p.F517S) in BCA, that was mutually exclusive with the previously reported CTNNB1 p.I35T gain-of-function (GoF) mutation. These driver events collectively accounted for 94% of BCAs. In vitro , mutant FBXW11 had a dominant negative affect, characterised by defective binding to β-catenin and the accumulation of β-catenin in cells. This was consistent with the nuclear expression of β-catenin observed in BCA cases harbouring the FBXW11 p.F517S mutation and activation of the Wnt/β-catenin pathway. The genomic profiles of BCAC were distinct from BCA, with hotspot DICER1 and HRAS mutations and putative driver mutations affecting PI3K/AKT and NF-κB signalling pathway genes. A single BCAC, which may represent a malignant transformation of BCA, harboured the recurrent FBXW11 mutation. These findings have important implications for the diagnosis and treatment of BCA and BCAC, which, despite histopathologic overlap, may be unrelated entities.
abstract_zh: Wnt信号传导必须“恰到好处”才能促进肿瘤生长。唾液腺的基底细胞腺瘤（BCA）和基底细胞腺癌（BCAC）是罕见肿瘤，彼此之间以及与其他唾液腺肿瘤亚型难以区分。由于其罕见性，BCA和BCAC的遗传谱尚未得到广泛探索。通过对BCA和BCAC队列进行全外显子组和转录组测序，我们在BCA中发现了一种新的复发性FBXW11错义突变（p.F517S），该突变与先前报道的CTNNB1 p.I35T功能获得性（GoF）突变互斥。这些驱动事件 collectively 占BCA病例的94%。在体外，突变型FBXW11具有显性负效应，其特征是与β-catenin的结合缺陷以及细胞中β-catenin的积累。这与在携带FBXW11 p.F517S突变的BCA病例中观察到的β-catenin核表达以及Wnt/β-catenin通路激活一致。BCAC的基因组谱与BCA不同，具有热点DICER1和HRAS突变，以及影响PI3K/AKT和NF-κB信号通路基因的推定驱动突变。一个可能代表BCA恶性转化的BCAC病例携带了复发性FBXW11突变。这些发现对BCA和BCAC的诊断和治疗具有重要意义，尽管两者在组织病理学上有重叠，但可能是无关的实体。
